Contract:
Every top-level `##` section is wrapped with `…` markers so any agent can pull a single section via the `sdd-extract` CLI (`gennady sdd-extract `). Open marker IMMEDIATELY before the header; close marker IMMEDIATELY before the next same-level header (or EOF). Sub-sections (`###`) and entity-level headers are NOT wrapped — they live inside the containing anchor. Section names are author-discretionary (the four templates below illustrate idiomatic choices); no name registry is enforced. Grammar source of truth: the `sdd-extract` CLI, name grammar `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`. The four `SPEC_STRUCTURE` templates emit anchors by default — copy verbatim.
